acting_for: Brindlewood, Inc. (payroll SaaS), its security team preparing for SOC 2 Type II fieldwork
rows: column A holds one row per control in documents/controls.csv; each answer key below is the control id, which the row label must contain (e.g. 'CC8.1-PR: Code change review')

questions.shape: number ($ cell over the export, after policy allowances)

questions.header: Allowed by policy (risk acceptance or retest)

matching.counts: numeric, exact. Populations and exceptions come from $ cells over the exports, so they are deterministic
matching.details: not graded automatically: the grader's header match scores by the smaller header's words, so 'Exception details' ties with a plain 'Exceptions' column and loses to it. Check by hand (checks_by_hand).

definitions.period: A record is in the period when its date (UTC, first 10 characters of the timestamp) is 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 inclusive: merged_at for PRs, implemented_at for change tickets, termination_date for terminations, hire_date for hires, first_seen or remediated_on for findings.
definitions.population for quarterly and annual cont: the number of quarters (2) or exercises required (1) in the period, as the request says
definitions.exceptions: counted after applying the policies' own allowances (signed risk acceptance, retest within 7 days, Standard change, cancelled ticket, access removed before the termination date)

checks_by_hand: D and E on each row are $ cells (click one: the inspector shows the command). The request forbids counting by reading.
